macros.name: SemantexArgKeysSet
macros.doc: Sets the argument 〈keys〉.

macros.name: SemantexArgKeysSetx
macros.doc: Sets the argument 〈keys〉, but fully expands their values.

macros.name: SemantexArgSingleKeysSet
macros.doc: Sets the argument keys 〈keys〉, but only supports keys taking no values.

macros.name: SemantexArgSingleKeysSetx
macros.doc: Sets the argument keys 〈keys〉, but only supports keys taking no values. If a key is not found, the value is fully expanded and printed.

macros.name: SemantexArgWithoutKeyvalSet
macros.doc: Sets the argument, allowing no keyval syntax.

macros.name: SemantexBoolProvide
macros.doc: Provides a new piece of data consisting of a boolean.

macros.name: SemantexBoolSetFalse
macros.doc: Sets the 〈boolean〉 to false.

macros.name: SemantexBoolSetTrue
macros.doc: Sets the 〈boolean〉 to true.

macros.name: SemantexDataClear
macros.doc: Clears the piece of data 〈data〉.

macros.name: SemantexDataGet
macros.doc: Returns the value of 〈data〉.

macros.name: SemantexDataGetExpNot
macros.doc: Returns the value of 〈data〉, enclosed in \unexpanded so that it can be used within an x-type expansion.

macros.name: SemantexDataProvide
macros.doc: Provides a new piece of data consisting of a token list.

macros.name: SemantexDataPutLeft
macros.doc: Adds the 〈value〉 to the left of 〈data〉.

macros.name: SemantexDataPutLeftx
macros.doc: Adds the 〈value〉 to the left of 〈data〉, but fully expands the 〈value〉 first.

macros.name: SemantexDataPutRight
macros.doc: Adds the 〈value〉 to the right of 〈data〉.

macros.name: SemantexDataPutRightx
macros.doc: Adds the 〈value〉 to the right of 〈data〉, but fully expands the 〈value〉 first.

macros.name: SemantexDataSet
macros.doc: Sets the 〈data〉 to 〈value〉.

macros.name: SemantexDataSetx
macros.doc: Sets the 〈data〉 to 〈value〉, but fully expands the 〈value〉 first.

macros.name: SemantexERROR
macros.doc: Issues an generic error message.

macros.name: SemantexERRORArgKeyValueNotFound
macros.doc: Issues an error, saying that the argument key 〈key〉 was set to the unknown value 〈value〉.

macros.name: SemantexERRORKeyValueNotFound
macros.doc: Issues an error, saying that the key 〈key〉 was set to the unknown value 〈value〉.

macros.name: SemantexExpNot
macros.doc: An alias for \unexpanded (also known as \exp_not:N in LATEX3).

macros.name: SemantexIntClear
macros.doc: Clears the 〈integer〉, i.e. sets it to 0.

macros.name: SemantexIntGet
macros.doc: Returns the value of the 〈integer〉.

macros.name: SemantexIntIncr
macros.doc: Increases the 〈integer〉 by 1.

macros.name: SemantexIntProvide
macros.doc: Provides a new piece of data consisting of an integer.

macros.name: SemantexIntSet
macros.doc: Sets the 〈integer〉 to 〈value〉.

macros.name: SemantexKeysSet
macros.doc: Sets the 〈keys〉.

macros.name: SemantexKeysSetx
macros.doc: Sets the 〈keys〉, but fully expands their values.

macros.name: SemantexOneSingleArgKeySet
macros.doc: Sets one single argument key taking no values.

macros.name: SemantexOneSingleArgKeySetx
macros.doc: Sets one single argument key taking no values, If the key is not found, the value is fully expanded and printed.

macros.name: SemantexSetArgKeys
macros.doc: Sets the argument 〈keys〉.

macros.name: SemantexSetArgKeysx
macros.doc: Sets the argument 〈keys〉, but fully expands their values.

macros.name: SemantexSetArgSingleKeys
macros.doc: Sets the argument keys 〈keys〉, but only supports keys taking no values.

macros.name: SemantexSetArgSingleKeysx
macros.doc: Sets the argument keys 〈keys〉, but only supports keys taking no values. If a key is not found, the value is fully expanded and printed.

macros.name: SemantexSetArgWithoutKeyval
macros.doc: Sets the argument, allowing no keyval syntax.

macros.name: SemantexSetKeys
macros.doc: Sets the 〈keys〉.

macros.name: SemantexSetKeysx
macros.doc: Sets the 〈keys〉, but fully expands their values.

macros.name: SemantexSetOneArgSingleKey
macros.doc: Sets one single argument key taking no values.

macros.name: SemantexSetOneArgSingleKeyx
macros.doc: Sets one single argument key taking no values, If the key is not found, the value is fully expanded and printed.

macros.name: SemantexThis
macros.doc: Returns the name of the current class or object.
